independentWork: Since g is the identity, g(2)=2, g(3)=3, and g(1)=1. From f(2)=g(2), f(2)=2. The remaining bijective assignments are either identity on {1,3} or the swap. The inequality 3f(1)≠f(3) excludes the identity and forces f(1)=3, f(3)=1. Hence (f∘f)(3)=3, f^{-1}(1)=3, and the sum is 8, choice ⑤.
